title: Fabric debug snapshot
description: Live fabric-router values captured by ttexalens on one host.

captured_at.description: Time at which creation of this snapshot file began.

samples.description: One sample in v1. An array is used so later polling support is additive.

manifest_reference.description: Identifies the manifest used for target selection. sha256 is the file-to-file pairing (hash of the manifest bytes as read). The path is informational only and must not be used to merge files after they have been copied. run.written_at is not copied; the hash already identifies the file.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the manifest file bytes as captured.

host_rank.description: Mesh-graph host rank. This is not necessarily the MPI process rank.

mpi_rank.description: MPI process rank copied from the manifest. Used to identify this host's files after they are copied and renamed.

endpoint.description: Globally stable identity of one fabric-router ERISC: one ethernet tile and physical cable endpoint.

capture_time.description: Time at which this sample began.

router_sample.description: Live values read from one fabric-router ERISC.

physical_chip_id.description: ttexalens device id on the host that performed this capture.

error.description: Null on success; otherwise a description of why this intended router could not be read.

streams.description: Raw overlay values keyed by numeric stream id encoded as a JSON string. Stream names are deliberately deferred to the per-router ABI.

reset.description: Raw ETH_RISC_RESET register value, or null if unreadable.

wall_clock.description: 64-bit wall clock assembled as high << 32 | low, or null if unreadable.

buf_space_available.description: Masked REMOTE_DEST_BUF_SPACE_AVAILABLE value. Without per-router ABI, stream ids are opaque: current conventional polarity is high-is-healthy for streams 14-29 and low-is-healthy for streams 0-13.
